change_summary: Added a runtime-only backtester exit rule controlled by `PRE_EARNINGS_EXIT_DAYS` and screened `1/2/3` trading-day exits before the next earnings event for already-open A+B positions. The rule closed positions at the same-day close only when stop/target had not already fired. No production trading logic was kept after measurement.
component: runtime-only patch of `quant/backtester.py` position exit loop (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: Every tested blanket pre-earnings exit improved at least one weaker window, but all of them failed the actual promotion test because the dominant late-strong window regressed materially. The forced exits were mostly not catastrophe avoidance; they clipped still-profitable continuation names such as `XOM`, `ISRG`, `SPOT`, and `DIS` before the move finished.

hypothesis: If A+B alpha is leaking through avoidable earnings-gap exposure, then forcing `trend_long` / `breakout_long` positions to exit a fixed number of trading days before the next earnings date should improve the accepted A+B stack across the deterministic late / mid / old windows. A valid rule must preserve or improve the dominant late-strong window while helping the weaker tapes.
next_retry_requires: Do not retry another blanket `1/2/3-day` A+B pre-earnings exit permutation by default
If earnings-aware exit work returns, require a richer selector than fixed days-only logic
Prefer either a different unblocked alpha branch or a production/backtest exit-parity repair before more exit micro-tuning
notes: This stayed a single-causal-variable experiment: only the holding-period exit rule changed, and only for open A+B positions approaching earnings. Entries, sizing, ranking, and accepted cohort rules were left unchanged. The temporary backtester patch was removed after the failed screen.

parameters.calendar_source: single cached `yfinance get_earnings_dates()` pull reused across all variants

selector.rule: force exit at same-day close when next earnings date is within N trading days and no stop/target already triggered

rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. The family behaves like premature profit clipping rather than a stable repo-level risk control: it rescues some weaker tapes but gives up too much of the main-window continuation edge.
